ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The tale's established English title is used. Its folk repetitions are kept, including the doubled verbs «севать не севал… жинать не жинал» (sevat' ne seval… zhinat' ne zhinal, 'sow it I never sowed… reap it I never reaped'), the present-tense slips, and «зеленый» (zelyony, 'green') for the first old man; «земля божья» (zemlya bozh'ya) is 'God's land', without the website draft's 'the Lord's' or its 'land as private property'.

Source observation: [7] The tsar's first question to the first old man opens with « but is never closed («…не покупывал ли где такого зерна?»), unlike the identical question in [9]; probably a lost closing ». The English reproduces the unclosed quotation.
